metadata.case_name: ERWIANA SULISTYANINGSIH v. LAW WAN TUNG

plaintiff.occupation_after: pursuing a university degree in management and economics (student)
plaintiff.education_level: pursuing a university degree in management and economics

injuries.description: three 3cm lacerations on the forehead, bleeding at the sub-conjunctiva, bruises on upper and lower eyelids, red dots over her face, laceration with a length of 2cm on the nose, scar on the upper lip, two upper front teeth broken, old nose bone fracture, maxilla fracture.
source: Injuries to the head region – three 3cm lacerations on the forehead, bleeding at the sub-conjunctiva, bruises on upper and lower eyelids, red dots over her face, laceration with a length of 2cm on the nose, scar on the upper lip, two upper front teeth broken, old nose bone fracture, maxilla fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

injuries.description: brain concussion, cerebral edema and cerebellum edema, gliosis or neural brain damage, ataxia, double vision.
source: Neurology – brain concussion, cerebral edema and cerebellum edema, gliosis or neural brain damage, ataxia, double vision.
injuries.icd_description: Diffuse injury of multiple parts of brain

injuries.description: Infection wounds – scars on hands in the form of laceration wounds and scar wounds caused by allergy (contact dermatitis), infection wounds (cellulitis) on the legs probably caused by dermatitis with secondary infection.
source: Infection wounds – scars on hands in the form of laceration wounds and scar wounds caused by allergy (contact dermatitis), infection wounds (cellulitis) on the legs probably caused by dermatitis with secondary infection.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of wrist or hand

injuries.description: dermatitis scars and discolouration of the skin on her feet, ankles and lower calves; scars around neck, forehead, shoulder, wrists and behind her ears caused by repeated beatings.
injuries.body_part: feet, ankles, lower calves; face and neck (scars)
source: Physically, the plaintiff says that she has now recovered satisfactorily with little abnormality or residual disability except for dermatitis scars and discolouration of the skin on her feet, ankles and lower calves.
I have also sustained scars around my neck, forehead, shoulder, wrists and behind my ears caused by the Defendant's repeated beatings with either a steel hanger or ruler or other objects.

injuries.description: two 2cm laceration wounds on left shoulder region; blister wounds measuring 2cm on the back; one old wound at the rear part of the left ear; one old wound about 1 to 2cm in diameter on the back just about the hip.
injuries.body_part: left shoulder; back; left ear; hip area
source: Others – two 2cm laceration wounds on left shoulder region, two blister wounds measuring 2cm on the back, one old wound at the rear part of the left ear, and one old wound about 1 to 2cm in diameter on the back just about the hip.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of shoulder or upper arm

source: The diagnosis is post-traumatic stress disorder:

“The Posttraumatic Stress Disorder started in the first one month after returning back to Indonesia. The symptoms have improved with time. Currently the level of severity is assessed to be moderate.” (at paragraph 15.7)
“Her psychiatric illnesses arose directly from the Incidents that occurred while she was living and working at the home of the Defendant.” (at paragraph 15.11)
She is also diagnosed with major depressive disorder:
“The Major Depressive Disorder started during her time in Hong Kong and the symptoms have improved with time. Currently, the level of severity is assessed to be moderate.” (at paragraph 15.9)

manifestations.description: loss of concentration and becoming forgetful
feeling ashamed and afraid to mingle with classmates and others
had to use adult diapers because she became physically weak and could not go to the toilet
dermatitis sores, blisters and scarring on hands, feet and ankles

treatments_received: admitted to Amal Sehat Islamic Hospital Sragen; various scans and examinations; Head CT scan performed in late 2015; dental repair of cracked and displaced front teeth; follow-up consultations in Indonesia throughout 2015
treatments_future: psychiatric follow-up on a monthly basis for two years
antidepressant medication treatment to be taken for at least one year (and likely to require two years depending on response)
psychological treatment by a clinical psychologist (each session for 40 to 50 minutes) on a weekly basis for half a year, and every two weeks afterwards for another one year

losses.description: Embarrassment to wear clothing revealing injuries such as skirts, dresses or sandals.
Ashamed and afraid to mingle with classmates and others.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Lost pleasure in her interests and sometimes cries; reduced enjoyment in past interests.
Loses concentration easily and sometimes mind becomes completely blank; more forgetful.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Continues to feel ashamed and afraid to mingle and is embarrassed to wear certain clothing revealing her injuries.
